steps.content:
1:21 p.m., October 14, N.F. 112
Inside the MBCC Bureau
Due to the arrival of the Paradeisos guest, there have been subtle shifts within the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Take a look! These are the flowers I had Miss Shalom pick out for the office. Hehe, she's even going to teach me flower arranging later. What a wonderful person!

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: ...Does the office usually keep flowers around?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Ah, there's the philistine who can't appreciate beauty!

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Weren't you deeply skeptical of the new inspector before? What made you switch sides so quickly?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Ahem, she's not only gentle and attractive but also a high-ranking official from Paradeisos. She was exceptionally cooperative when I had her sign the visitor's log last time—no pretense whatsoever.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I always thought Paradeisos folks were enigmatic, but who knew you'd find such a gentle soul among them, huh?

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Wow, is it really proper for someone like that to be in a regular room? Every time I bring food, I'm on pins and needles. I can't even bring myself to joke with the Sinners nearby anymore.

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: What's the issue? The real power players are here for this very scrutiny. I've been watching— she observes the Bureau casually while engaging in light conversation. She's nothing like the empty suits in Eastside; these are people who genuinely make things happen.

steps.speaker: Staff B
steps.content: We had a conversation, and she remembered me—and my job—from just a single meeting. Do you think if I impress, that high-ranking Paradeisos official might green-light my transfer? This place is alright, but I have my sights set on something better...
Nightingale steps into the corridor, but suddenly stops, her eyes filled with tension as she looks toward the far end of the hallway.
Her gaze settles on Shalom. Standing beside an MBCC employee, the Hush listens attentively, as if deeply contemplating the question posed by the other person.

Seemingly aware of others's gaze, Shalom turns her head and locks eyes with Nightingale. Upon seeing Nightingale's pallid face, Shalom smiles. She responds to the question posed by the person beside her, but her eyes remain fixed on Nightingale until she hastily turns away.
Just as she observes the entire Bureau, you are also closely watching Shalom. You know very little about her background, but one thing becomes increasingly clear: she is highly dangerous.

Unlike any other Sinners you've encountered, Shalom hasn't shown any extraordinary Arcane Tendencies. Yet, she has an uncanny knack for pinpointing vulnerabilities and exerting her influence. Just like she did with you yesterday, all of it happened without a trace.
You can't control any of this. You can't read her, much less rein her in, and you're starting to question — has the Bureau already fallen under her influence?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Have you shackled her yet?
...If there's a chance to put the shackles on her, would things really get better?
What's on your mind?
A voice, cool and piercing, jolts you into lifting your head. Shalom has appeared beside you at some point, wearing a smile.

She's wearing gloves, as if Paradeisos is subtly warning you about using your shackles. Yet, the unabashed openness of her exposed skin seems to brazenly communicate: even if it's the MBCC, as long as you're under their watch, you're powerless to make any moves.
You take a fleeting glance at the task sheet in your hand and offer her a smile.

options: I've just been assigned a field mission.

choices.text: I've just been assigned a field mission.

steps.content: Care to join, Envoy? It's not too challenging, but... our approach has always been a bit unrestrained. We could use some guidance in standard procedures.
Hmm... we might encounter some skirmishes, nothing too serious but not too light either, if you're up for it...
Shalom's smile lingers, her eyes opening just a touch to lock onto yours. After a brief silence, she speaks with an unhurried grace.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No, I'd be more than happy to go with you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'd also like to bear witness to your battle.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, I've forwarded the map to you. The MBCC squad will coordinate with FAC forces to intercept smugglers along Route B. High chance the target is infected with Mania—exercise extreme caution.
Combat stretched through the morning. The mission wasn't particularly tough but did prove to be a hassle, as the battlegrounds kept shifting.

The West District remains a cauldron of chaos and violence, but the esteemed envoy from Paradeisos seems perfectly at ease amid the grueling fieldwork. She stands beside you, buffeted by the fierce wind. Today, she's exceptionally close.

Close enough for you to clearly see every inch of her exposed skin, enticing you to contemplate certain "justifiable" uses for shackles, such as... shielding her from the ravages of Mania amidst the chaos.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I've been waiting so long I'm starving... Hey, ${PlayerName}, is your intel accurate or not?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Keep it down, the enemy could show up any second. You'll blow our cover.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We've conquered the Black Ring together; there's no hurdle we haven't overcome.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you saying you're actually scared of these underlings, Hecate?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Taking down the enemy is only part of the mission. We're also responsible for the safety of Chief and the Inspector—there's no room for complacency.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Right... it's not just ${PlayerName} this time; even the new inspector can't fight.
Hella turns to Shalom, sizes her up, and lets out a sigh.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ${PlayerName} once mentioned that he's surrounded by many who are not just capable but also deeply trustworthy. Among them is a Sinner from Syndicate, someone he deems reliable.
steps.female_content: ${PlayerName} once mentioned that she's surrounded by many who are not just capable but also deeply trustworthy. Among them is a Sinner from the Syndicate, someone she deems reliable.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your deeds have been chronicled in our operational reports and, to put it simply, they're extraordinary. We're deeply grateful for the sacrifices you've made for DisCity.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Capable? Ha, hahaha... Isn't it obvious? Do you even know who you're dealing with? I'm the most formidable Sinner in all of Minos!

Hella is clearly riding high on the praise, completely ensnared by the other party's trap. You furrow your brow, continue sifting through the clues as you step back, and covertly switch your earpiece to a private channel without making a sound.
Nightingale, allow Hella and Hecate to back up the other squads. I can handle things here with Shalom.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Chief, please don't act on a whim. We can't afford another mishap; I'm really worried about you.
The talks fall apart. Your adjutant stands her ground, clearly distressed by Shalom's presence.
You hadn't anticipated this tension would so quickly spread to you as well.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, stop messing around and stay sharp.

Your eyes meet Shalom's, but she's not looking at you for once—her focus is entirely on Hecate. You've never seen her wear such a look before—a complex mix of observation, deep thought, and a hint of caution.
An instant wave of dread surges up your spine as you instinctively leap forward to break them up, completely blind to the impending peril. A sudden, focused onslaught of Mania firepower engulfs you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!

Just in the nick of time, Nightmare leaps in to shield you—and you bitterly wish it hadn't. The trio stands dangerously exposed, a looming explosion threatens to engulf them. In this dire moment, at this close range, you stretch your hand to release some unseen shackles, but they, too, elude your grasp.
A dense blue laser sweeps by, setting off a burst of fireworks less than a few meters away from them.
Shalom steps forward; Schorl floats up in tandem with her hand gesture. A halo of light locks onto the unseen assailant, instantly neutralizing the ambush with a wave of cold, silent killing intent.
Shalom mutters, and you clearly grasp her command.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Attack.
Lasers pour down from the sky, and a colossal shockwave nearly upends you.
When the blinding light fades, only you and the Sinners remain standing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: *****... What is that...?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The mission's complete, ${PlayerName}. We can head back now.
She takes a slight step back, unveiling Hecate who was hiding behind her. Hecate is taken aback as she sees the wound on Shalom's shoulder.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You...
A wave of tension washes over you, as you anticipate Shalom making some sort of comment.
But she doesn't say anything, simply lets go of Hecate's hand, stands up, and walks straight towards you.
She avoids eye contact, but as she glides past you, she leaves behind a whisper meant solely for the two of you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Did you think I was going to do something?
Your breath hitches. Shalom's smile persists, but now it's tinged with coldness, a blatant sneer shining through.
She derides your exaggerated caution, which has only blinded you, causing you to lose your cool and make poor decisions. Even if she says nothing, you're rendered speechless.
Yet she chooses to speak.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Don't worry, I have no intention of harming her. These are the people who mean the most to you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Go on, she needs you more than anyone else.
She walks away, leaving you rooted to the spot.
On closer look, you see that the envoy's shoulder wound is more serious than you initially thought, skillfully masked by her unwavering composure.
After Hella's spirited promotion, word of the envoy's prowess on the battlefield quickly spread across the Bureau. Rumors casting the Chief in a less-than-flattering light also started to circulate.
Nightingale is noticeably anxious, while Shalom remains unflappable. Schorl, on the other hand, seems more invigorated than ever, becoming a chatterbox whenever it receives a compliment.
You feel somewhat disheartened.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Attack.
You grasp the first point—the underlying message behind the Paradeisos announcement: <color=#fb9259>shackles aren't needed</color>, signaling dire consequences for anyone daring to defy.
To put it bluntly, as long as she remains, you're powerless—reduced to a mere observer. And you're left wondering how long she'll stay and what other cards she has up her sleeve.
As for the second point... it comes from an intuition you can't quite pin down, making you hesitate just before letting things simply unfold.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Go, she needs you more than anyone else right now.

Before she navigated the intricate dynamics of the cutthroat workplace, you distinctly recall her taking that step not to intimidate the enemy but to shield the young girl behind her. All the unsavory actions that followed seemed more like a masquerade to embellish this rift.
Is that really the case? You hesitate to confirm, fearing this may just be a projection of your own hidden agenda.

Every action this woman takes is subject to dual interpretations. Trust her, and you're awash in sweetness; doubt her, and you plummet into an endless abyss of suspicion, fraught with unease over her vagueness. Strangely, this makes you yearn for the fleeting moments when you allowed yourself to be vulnerable around her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You possess a force that is both potent and enigmatic, eliciting fear, hatred, or envy from people across all organizations. How you are perceived can shift at any given moment.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So, <color=#fb9259>firm up your own convictions</color>, keep your eyes peeled, and gather all the intel you can. Seek out the force that you can wield and believe in; that's what you should be focusing on.
At least you would agree with these words no matter who said them.
Rather than blindly following others, you tread your own path.
You rise and send a communication request to the chamber of the Paradeisos envoy.
As you approach the door, Shalom is gently tapping on Schorl. She watches a triangular device hum to life, her face lighting up as if she were playing with a kitten.
I want to talk to you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Hmm? Do you want to talk about the past, or some new problems you've run into?

options: No, this time it's you I want to talk about.

choices.text: No, this time it's you I want to talk about.

steps.content: The room falls silent for a beat. Schorl hovers silently in the air.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...I've noticed, you've been watching me intently all day.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's clear you're questioning my motives for being here. You'd like nothing more than to shackle me, wouldn't you?

Thank you for helping everyone today; I've done some soul-searching myself. Holding onto such childish animosities really serves no purpose—I've only been someone else's puppet. Going forward, I won't act recklessly until I have all the facts.
You said you came here to dissolve my mistrust toward Paradeisos, but it seems the tables have turned. Paradeisos doesn't trust me; that's why they sent you.
She gazes at you in thoughtful silence for a lingering moment.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Making you uneasy was never my intent—it runs counter to everything I meant to do.
If you genuinely despise me, why not just attack outright? You've flaunted your overwhelming power but haven't aimed it at me.
Does this mean Paradeisos is genuinely seeking to engage with me, an encounter I can't dodge?
Well then, I'll meet it head-on.

options: What does Paradeisos make of me? What are they after?

choices.text: What does Paradeisos make of me? What are they after?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I can't reveal any further details.
Like you pointed out, Paradeisos's sole aim is to seek out the nearly impossible solution for preserving human civilization in the face of apocalyptic ruin. My mission is just as singular—

options: to guard this haven and protect those who mean the world to me.

choices.text: to guard this haven and protect those who mean the world to me.

steps.content: I'm not so complex as to warrant such earnest treatment from you. I have no hidden past; what you see is what you get. You've shaped me, and so there's nothing for me to hide.

If you're interested in fostering a good relationship, simply respecting this stance will suffice. If you're concerned I'll sow chaos, just avoid crossing the line. My impatience today arose because I felt threatened by you. I'm being honest and would appreciate it if you'd cease such actions.
Beyond that, I can't foresee any inherent conflict between our positions, so I'm open to exploring a path of mutual advancement—consistent with what you've previously conveyed to me.
You look into her eyes, and she looks back at you. Those eyes remain enigmatic, a misty veil you can't quite see through—but that's not what matters anymore.
What's important is the clarity you've found in your own thoughts.

options: The above are intended for the <color=#fb9259>envoy</color> as well as the <color=#fb9259>friend</color>.

choices.text: The above are intended for the <color=#fb9259>envoy</color> as well as the <color=#fb9259>friend</color>.

steps.content: Next, I ask that you demonstrate and substantiate the stance of Shalom. I shall respect your choice.

If you are ${PlayerName}'s friend, we have much more to discuss, and I genuinely need your assistance. If you're the envoy of Paradeisos, then the Chief of the MBCC has said all that's necessary; from this point, we can proceed in a strictly official capacity.
I have a multitude of tasks awaiting me; there's no need to squander time wallowing in ceaseless mistrust.
After a brief pause, Shalom looks up and says to Schorl,

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'd like to speak with him. Could we have some privacy?
steps.female_content: I'd like to speak with her. Could we have some privacy?

steps.content: The triangular elemental appears to ponder for a moment before finally stepping back, giving you two your privacy.
You find yourself with a rare chance to be alone with Shalom, a situation that exceeds your expectations in an oddly unsettling way.

options: ...Is it really okay to let it go?

choices.text: ...Is it really okay to let it go?

steps.content: Paradeisos doesn't want you to accept the shackles, signifying they're wary of you forming a deep connection with me. Taking such a step would only raise their suspicions further.
Shalom looks at you and smiles. You suddenly feel as if one of her many facades has just fallen away.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It doesn't need eyes to understand what's happening.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I sent it away primarily for your sake.

Before you can even question it, Shalom is suddenly next to you, so close you can almost feel her breathing. As you take it all in, her hand softly lands on your shoulder, her body leaning in, her whisper almost touching your ear.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You'd feel awkward if we weren't alone, wouldn't you?
With just a gentle push, you find yourself falling back onto the lounge's bed.
Her force is minimal; you could've easily resisted, but you can't. You're immobilized, your body feels like lead, and your thoughts blur into confusion.
It's as if something intangible has bound you—something that's neither her nor anything physical. A dim light seems to ascend your body slowly, almost hauntingly.
...Let go! What are you doing to me?!
The other person grins, eyes locking onto yours as she looks down.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Why so tensed up? You've come a long way; yet so naive still?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Shh... stay still... I won't hurt you, don't worry; I won't go further. Just relax, it won't hurt.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If you keep resisting, it's hard on me too—you'll end up hurting both of us...

With a soft thud, the sound of fabric meets the ground. She removes her black gloves, and her slightly cool palms touch you again. Her slender fingers lightly grasp your wrist, gently caressing your skin as they slide upwards to intertwine with your fingers.
Simultaneously, the light climbs up your waist, tightening its grip, leaving you disoriented. Shalom's soft laughter brushes against your earlobe.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're torn between fleeing and drawing closer, between fearing me and wanting to surpass me. You shy away from my deep scrutiny, but you yearn to unveil every part of me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You wish to delve into my true thoughts, to have me lay bare my entire being before you. Then use the shackles; I'll show you the depths of my soul.

You feel increasingly frustrated as you struggle with all your might. One hand does manage to break free and reaches for her collarbone, attempting to push her away. However, your movements are arrested by the vivid white light that holds you in place. Almost immediately, a hand that looks all too human gently rests on the back of your own.
She smiles and, holding your hand, slowly glides it across her skin. Ultimately, she places it against her neck, exposing her vulnerability as if inviting you into a psychological hunt.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: One of the conditions for activation is skin-to-skin contact, right?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If not having shackles on me is unsettling you, then go ahead. It's all good. I completely understand. I'll meet your needs.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Isn't this what you've been yearning to do? You've gone through so much; you've earned this.

Something is infiltrating your awareness. You yearn to resist, but you find yourself drained of strength. You can't help but watch her as she leans over, her face drawing closer to yours with deliberate slowness, her voice increasingly elusive as it drifts into your ears.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I grant you permission to do whatever you desire. Anything you wish to do, it's not a concern; you have the prerogative.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Just be certain. What do you truly seek from me?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Be certain... And then proceed...
Your hand involuntarily tightens, gripping Shalom's throat. The shackles crawl up Shalom's skin, hot patterns spreading within her, only to be hindered.

The shackles feel off to the touch. A more aggressive force seems to have been roused by you, erupting through Shalom's body—almost skewering her. Its form is unsettling, nearly shattered to pieces. Is this—
Whose is it?! Who else could...
Shalom wears an expression of regret.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So you really can't remember, huh? Look carefully... The one who bestowed me with the shackles...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Is <color=#fb9259>you</color>.

A triangular glyph appears in Shalom's right eye. Something penetrates your flesh, intruding directly into your mind and compelling a connection. Is this a shackle or merely a light? Either way, it's foreign to you.
Your body starts to go numb, but your soul quivers from the raw contact. In an instant, you feel weightless—swept away entirely by the experience.
